title:
A basic utility type for other types/instances whose implementation is backed by 'native' Python files/code.

**NOTE**: This type cannot be an entity since some types that inherit from it (e.g. {@link GenaiCore.Tool.NativePy})
already extend an entity type, but it is expected that all concrete instances of this type will be entities.
